Gulielmi Robertsoni, Angli, A.M. Manipulus linguæ sanctæ Hebræo-biblici concordantiale lexicon, editus, sed jam latinitate donatus, et textibus locupletatus, Johanne Leusden.
Lexicon novum Chaldaeo-Biblicum, Ad modum Lexici Schreveliani Græci in Danielem & Esram, compositum. Johanne Leusden. Ultrajecti, apud Franciscum Halma, 1687.
Abbreviaturæ peculiares in hoc Lexico Chaldaico usitatæ:
Lexicon novum Chaldaeo-Biblicum, In Danielem & Esram.

book: Two-part Hebrew-Latin and Chaldee-Latin lexicon by Johannes Leusden (Utrecht, 1687): the Hebrew lexicon with front matter (dedication, preface, list of disputing students, abbreviations) runs first, followed by the Chaldee lexicon with its own title page and abbreviation list.
